name: The Social Enterprise
registeredName: Chris Charis Social Enterprise for Art and Tech LTD/GTE
line: The registered not-for-profit at the centre of everything we do.
description: Chris Charis Concept is the trading name of Chris Charis Social Enterprise for Art and Tech LTD/GTE (RC 9786077), a not-for-profit social enterprise in Benin City, Nigeria, that uses filmmaking, creative media, arts and technology to drive community development, skills and social impact. Since August 2020 it has produced advocacy films, run community health and mental health campaigns, built leadership programmes, and launched the Fusion Creative Project for young creatives and technologists.
relationship: The parent organisation. Every project and arm carries the line “a Chris Charis Concept initiative”.
offerings: Audiovisual and digital content for education, public enlightenment, advocacy and cultural development
Training, workshops, mentorship and skills acquisition in creative arts, media and digital technology
Creative and technology hubs, learning platforms and community-based programmes
enquiryText: We work with governments, NGOs, educational institutions, private organisations, development partners and donor agencies.

name: Fusion Connect Academy
line: Creative and technology education that turns talent into skill.
relationship: Born from the Fusion Creative Project. With Fusion Solutions Hub, it forms the “Earn & Lead” stage of our pathway.

description: At FUSION Solution Hub, we empower individuals and businesses to thrive in an ever-evolving world by providing innovative, sustainable solutions to complex problems. relationship: Born from the Fusion Creative Project. With Fusion Connect Academy, it forms the “Earn & Lead” stage of our pathway.
enquiryText: Tell us about your project and the Fusion Solutions Hub team will get back to you.
